name: Qingdao Municipal People's Government (Qingdao SASAC)
via: city-level government of Qingdao, Shandong, China; its State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Qingdao SASAC) exercises the state's ownership rights in the city's state-owned enterprises
note: Qingdao SASAC wholly owns both Tsingtao Brewery Group Co., Ltd. and Qingdao Beverage Group Co., Ltd., per Tsingtao Brewery's 2025 annual report and Shandong Business Journal's Subao News (2025-03-27).
